Internal zeroing is not equivalent to deleting interactions. Without a key-padding mask, zero slots still enter attention’s softmax denominator; positional embeddings, projection biases and intermediate states can also make them nonzero. The inspected [SASRec implementation](https://github.com/pmixer/SASRec.pytorch/blob/master/python/model.py) supplies only a causal mask and reads the final array slot. Mechanistic implication: internal holes can create padding artifacts, while deletion followed by chronological repacking and left-padding changes surviving items’ absolute positions and spacing. Report fixed-position masking and compacted deletion as distinct interventions; neither alone isolates item identity from every positional effect.

Combine causality with exclusion of zero-valued keys at every layer, and suppress padded-query outputs. PyTorch MultiheadAttention boolean masks use True for exclusion; functional SDPA uses True for allowance. Gather the greatest nonzero sequence index, not nonzero-count minus one; the final slot is valid only when guaranteed occupied. Explicitly bypass empty histories with a declared fallback or exclude them and report coverage. Left padding plus causality can fully mask padded-query rows, so use safe attention handling and verify finite outputs; multiplying NaNs by zero does not fix them. See [mask semantics](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.MultiheadAttention.html) and [padding guidance](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/intermediate/transformer_building_blocks.html).

Recommended experimental design: preserve the original last interaction in both targeted and control histories to isolate earlier-history dependence; analyze last-item removal separately. Retention-only probes measure sufficiency under a specified transformation, not necessity or causal preference. Sample random control positions disjoint from targeted positions, matching intervention size and recency bins, with the same last-item rule, packing, readout and candidate set. Exempt any mandatory shared last-item anchor from disjointness. Use repeated seeded controls; report infeasible matches instead of silently allowing overlap or changing size.
